verifications.claim: As of late March 2026, 30-year fixed mortgage rates have risen.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Both are up by more than 25 basis points from their February levels'; R2: 'ticked up to an average of 6.74%... up from last week's 6.72%'; R3: 'Mortgage Rates Move Back Above 6.5% After hitting 5.99%'; R4: 'rose to 6.22% from 6.11% last week... risen every week since'.
verifications.reasoning: All references directly state or imply recent rises in 30-year fixed rates in late March 2026.

verifications.claim: As of late March 2026, many lenders average above 6.5% for 30-year fixed mortgage rates.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R3: 'top tier 30yr fixed mortgage rates are back over 6.5% for the average lender today'.
verifications.reasoning: R3 directly supports average lender rates over 6.5%; other sources report slightly lower survey averages but do not contradict as they represent different surveys.

verifications.claim: As of late March 2026, 30-year fixed mortgage rates have hit their highest levels in over three months.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R4: 'climbed this week to its highest level in more than three months'.
verifications.reasoning: R4 explicitly states the 6.22% rate is the highest in more than three months.

verifications.claim: Freddie Mac reported a 6.22% average 30-year fixed mortgage rate on March 19, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R4: 'The benchmark 30-year fixed rate mortgage rate rose to 6.22%... mortgage buyer Freddie Mac said Thursday' (context: Mar 19, 2026).
verifications.reasoning: R4 attributes exact 6.22% to Freddie Mac for the relevant weekly report around March 19.

verifications.claim: As of March 23, 2026, daily surveys indicate 30-year fixed mortgage rate averages closer to 6.37%–6.5%.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'The average mortgage interest rate on a 30-year mortgage is 6.37% as of March 23, 2026, according to Zillow' (daily survey source).
verifications.reasoning: R1 provides exact 6.37% from Zillow daily average on March 23, fitting the range.

verifications.claim: 30-year fixed mortgage rates fell below 6% briefly in early March 2026.
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: R3: 'hitting 5.99% as recently as February 27th'; R4: 'Only three weeks ago [~Feb 26-28 before Mar 19], the average rate had dropped to just under 6%'.
verifications.reasoning: References specify late February low below 6%, directly contradicting 'early March 2026' timing.

verifications.claim: 30-year fixed mortgage rates have increased after falling below 6% briefly in early March 2026.
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: R3: 'After hitting 5.99% as recently as February 27th'; R4: 'risen every week since [three weeks ago ~late Feb low under 6%]'.
verifications.reasoning: Increase after low is supported, but low attributed to late February, not early March, contradicting claim's timing.

verifications.claim: As of late March 2026, 30-year refinance rates average around 6.74% to 6.9%.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'The average mortgage refinance rate on a 30-year mortgage loan is 6.90% as of March 23, 2026'; R2: '30-year fixed refinance rate ticked up to an average of 6.74%... March 23, 2026'.
verifications.reasoning: Both R1 and R2 report refinance rates directly within or at the claimed range on March 23.
